title: Onde
description: Pieces in quantum superposition. Split a Wave into two 50/50 ghosts — reality only collapses at the moment of interaction. Capture the enemy Core while betting on which ghost is real. Play hotseat, against an honest AI, or online with a friend in a LOB7 room.
controls: Click a solid piece to move it; use the panel buttons to split a Wave into two ghosts or to collapse one of your own ghost pairs.
Entering a ghost cell forces its collapse — attacks can pass straight through.
Hotseat: pass the device between turns.
credits: A game by Cédric Bernadac, created with AI agents (ZCode & Kimi K3.1 Pro).
